units.source_text: 藏人少将明知无补于事，总想发些牢骚，便到藤侍从室中访问。

en.t: The Chamberlain Lieutenant knew perfectly well that it would do no good, but he still wanted to air his grievances, so he went to visit Fuji Jijū in his room.

units.source_text: 藤侍从正在阅读薰君寄来的信，看见藏人少将进来，正想把信隐藏，岂知藏人少将早已看出是薰君的来信，连忙把信夺去。

en.t: Fuji Jijū was reading a letter that Lord Kaoru had sent. When he saw the Chamberlain Lieutenant come in, he was about to hide it, but the Chamberlain Lieutenant had already realized that it was a letter from Lord Kaoru and quickly snatched it away.

units.source_text: 藤侍从心念如果坚决不给，他将疑心有何秘密，因此听其夺去。

en.t: Fuji Jijū thought that if he firmly refused to hand it over, the other man would suspect that some secret was involved, so he let him take it.

units.source_text: 信中并无要事，只是慨叹世事之不称意，微露怨恨之词而已。

en.t: There was nothing important in the letter; it merely lamented how unsatisfactory the world was and faintly revealed a few words of resentment.
